name: Queries
description: The collection of WorkbookQuery objects introduced in Office 2016.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns an integer that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: FastCombine
properties.description: True to enable the fast combine feature, as long as the workbook is open. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, Formula As String, [Description As Variant]) As WorkbookQuery
methods.description: Adds a new WorkbookQuery object to the Queries collection.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: The Power Query M formula for the new query.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: NameOrIndex
parameters.description: The name or index number of the item.
